title: The alphabet
goal: Name every planet, sign, house and nakshatra with its meaning, and read your own chart in the four-part model.

graha: “That which seizes.” The nine moving influences: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu. They are the actors of the chart.
rashi: A sign: one of 12 equal 30° slices of the sidereal zodiac. A planet in a sign takes on that sign’s style.
bhava: A house: an area of life. In whole-sign houses the lagna sign is house 1, the next sign house 2, and so on.
nakshatra: A lunar mansion: one of 27 slices of 13°20′. The Moon spends about a day in each. Your Moon’s nakshatra starts your dasha clock.
pada: A quarter of a nakshatra, 3°20′ wide. 108 padas in all; each pada equals one navamsa (D9) sign.
lagna: The ascendant: the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It changes about every 2 hours, which is why the exact birth time matters.
ayanamsa: The gap between the tropical and sidereal zodiacs, about 24° today and growing by about 50″ a year. Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) is the Indian government standard.
sidereal: A zodiac fixed to the stars. Jyotish uses it. It sits about 24° behind the tropical zodiac.
tropical: A zodiac fixed to the seasons (0° Aries = the March equinox). Western astrology uses it.
kendra: Angular houses 1, 4, 7, 10: the pillars of the chart. Planets here act strongly and visibly.
trikona: Trine houses 1, 5, 9: houses of merit and fortune. Their lords are counted auspicious, though a second lordship (for example of a dusthana) can mix the result.
dusthana: Difficult houses 6, 8, 12: disease and debt, sudden change, loss. Their lords placed in each other can give Viparita Raja Yoga, success through adversity.
upachaya: Growing houses 3, 6, 10, 11: results improve with time and effort. Malefics do well here.
karaka: Significator. A planet that naturally stands for something, whatever the chart: Sun = father, Moon = mother, Venus = wife, Jupiter = children and husband.
dasha: A planetary period. In the Vimshottari system a 120-year cycle is shared by the nine planets; the running dasha lord decides which promises open now.
gochar: Transit: where the planets are moving now, read against the birth chart.
dignity: How comfortable a planet is in a sign: exalted (best), moolatrikona, own sign, friend’s, neutral, enemy’s, debilitated (weakest).
vargottama: A planet in the same sign in D1 and D9. Treated as strong and reliable. Your Mercury is vargottama in Gemini.
retrograde: A planet that appears to move backward from Earth. Classically it gains strength but delivers in an unusual or delayed way.
combust: A planet too close to the Sun, its light swallowed. It loses some independence. Your Mars is about 11° from the Sun, inside the 17° orb given for Mars in the Surya Siddhanta and BPHS tables. Some teachers use smaller orbs or ignore combustion across a sign edge (your Mars is in Taurus, the Sun in Gemini).
neechabhanga: Cancellation of debilitation. Rule sets differ by text: Phaladeepika and BPHS-style rules look at the lord of the debilitation or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna or Moon; another rule uses the planet that exalts in the debilitation sign; a later rule uses the debilitated planet itself in a kendra from the Moon. Your Saturn (debilitated in Aries) is a cancellation candidate under two of the later rules: the Sun, exalted in Aries, is in your 10th, and Saturn is in a kendra (10th) from your Moon. The lords of Aries and Libra (Mars, Venus) are not in a kendra, so the first rule set does not apply. A later stage tests each rule set.
ida: The lunar channel, felt as breath flowing through the left nostril. Cooling, receptive, steady.
pingala: The solar channel, felt as breath flowing through the right nostril. Heating, active, forceful.
sushumna: The central channel, when both nostrils flow equally. Classically unsuited for worldly action, suited for meditation.
tattva: The five elements in Swara Shastra: earth, water, fire, air, ether. Each is said to predominate in turn within each nostril’s flow of about an hour.
swara: In Swara Shastra, the breath and which nostril it flows through at a given moment.

lessons.title: What Jyotish is, and the four-part model
lessons.body:
ज्योतिष means “the science of light”. It is one of the six Vedangas, the limbs that support the Vedas, and is traditionally called the eye of the Veda: it was first used to time rituals.

The three branches

BranchCoversExample
SiddhantaAstronomy and maths: where the planets areThe engine that computes your chart
HoraThe individual birth chart and its timingYour kundli, dashas, transits
SamhitaThe world: nations, weather, omens, auspicious times, buildingsMuhurta, Vastu, mundane astrology

Sidereal, not tropical

Western astrology uses the {{term:tropical|tropical zodiac}}, tied to the seasons. Jyotish uses the {{term:sidereal|sidereal zodiac}}, tied to the stars. Because Earth’s axis wobbles, the two drift apart by about 50″ a year. The gap, the {{term:ayanamsa|ayanamsa}}, is about 24° now. That is why most people’s Vedic Sun sign is one sign behind their Western one: born 26 June, you are a Western Cancer but a Vedic Gemini Sun.

The four-part model

PartThink of it asCountAnswers
{{term:graha|graha}}The actor9Who acts
{{term:rashi|rashi}}The costume, the style12How it acts
{{term:bhava|bhava}}The stage, the area of life12Where in life it acts
{{term:nakshatra|nakshatra}}The script underneath27Why, the deeper story, and when (dashas)

Every sentence in a reading is these four joined: planet + sign + house + nakshatra. The rest of Jyotish (aspects, yogas, dashas, divisional charts) refines those four.

In your chart

Moon (mind) in Cancer (its own sign: caring, protective) in the 11th house (gains, friends, networks) in Pushya (nourishing, dutiful, ruled by Saturn, deity Brihaspati the guru). Read together: a mind that feels deeply, protects its people, and finds fulfilment through networks and steady, dutiful work.

Remember
  • Jyotish = Vedanga, the eye of the Veda; three branches.
  • Sidereal zodiac; Lahiri ayanamsa ≈ 24°.
  • Graha → rashi → bhava → nakshatra: who, how, where, why.

Practice (10 min): write your Sun and Moon in the four-part form, the way the Moon is written above.
lessons.listen: Jyotish is one of the six Vedangas, called the eye of the Veda. It has three branches: Siddhanta, the astronomy; Hora, the birth chart; and Samhita, the world, omens and auspicious times. Jyotish uses the sidereal zodiac, fixed to the stars, about twenty four degrees behind the Western tropical zodiac. Every reading uses four parts: the graha is the actor, the rashi is its costume or style, the bhava is the stage or area of life, and the nakshatra is the script beneath it. Your Moon is in Cancer, in the eleventh house, in Pushya: an emotional, nurturing mind that works through friends, networks and gains, with a dutiful, guru-like undertone.

quiz.q: Which branch of Jyotish deals with the individual birth chart?
quiz.w: Hora is the natal branch; Siddhanta is astronomy; Samhita covers the world, omens and muhurta.

quiz.q: Why is a Western Cancer often a Vedic Gemini?
o: The ~24° ayanamsa between tropical and sidereal zodiacs
quiz.w: The sidereal zodiac sits about 24° behind the tropical one, so most placements slip back one sign.

quiz.q: In the four-part model, the bhava is…
quiz.w: Bhava = house = the area of life where the planet acts.

lessons.title: The nine grahas
lessons.body:
A {{term:graha|graha}} is not just a planet: it means “that which seizes”, an influence that takes hold of a part of life. Seven are visible bodies; Rahu and Ketu are the two points where the Moon’s path crosses the Sun’s, the eclipse points.

GrahaSanskritNatureSignifies (karaka)OwnsExaltedDebilitatedDay
SunSurya सूर्यMild maleficSoul, father, authority, government, vitalityLeoAries 10°LibraSunday
MoonChandra चन्द्रBenefic when brightMind, mother, emotions, the publicCancerTaurus 3°ScorpioMonday
MarsMangala मङ्गलMaleficCourage, siblings, land, energy, conflictAries, ScorpioCapricorn 28°CancerTuesday
MercuryBudha बुधBenefic (takes colour of company)Intellect, speech, trade, skills, youthGemini, VirgoVirgo 15°PiscesWednesday
JupiterGuru गुरुGreatest beneficWisdom, children, wealth, teacher, dharma, husbandSagittarius, PiscesCancer 5°CapricornThursday
VenusShukra शुक्रBeneficLove, wife, luxury, art, vehicles, beautyTaurus, LibraPisces 27°VirgoFriday
SaturnShani शनिGreatest maleficDiscipline, delay, labour, longevity, serviceCapricorn, AquariusLibra 20°AriesSaturday
RahuRahu राहुShadow maleficObsession, foreign lands, illusion, ambition (modern readings add technology)— (shadow)Taurus* Scorpio*—
KetuKetu केतुShadow maleficDetachment, past life, moksha, intuition— (shadow)Scorpio*Taurus*—

*Rahu’s and Ketu’s exaltation signs differ between texts; Taurus/Scorpio is the most common view.

Benefics and malefics

Natural benefics: Jupiter, Venus, a bright Moon, and Mercury when not joined by malefics. Natural malefics: Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, and mildly the Sun. This is the planet’s raw nature. Stage 4 adds the second layer, functional nature, which depends on which houses a planet rules for your lagna. That is why Jupiter is a natural benefic yet carries kendradhipati dosha for you.

Each planet is also a {{term:karaka|karaka}}

Whatever the chart, the Sun speaks for the father, the Moon for the mother, Mars for brothers and property, Mercury for education and trade, Jupiter for children and the guru, Venus for the wife and comforts, Saturn for servants, labour and longevity.

Strength in a sign: {{term:dignity|dignity}}

Best to worst: exalted → moolatrikona → own sign → friend’s sign → neutral → enemy’s sign → debilitated. Exaltation and debilitation are always opposite signs (Sun exalted in Aries, debilitated in Libra).

In your chart
PlanetSignDegreeHouseNakshatraDignity
SunGemini10°41′10Ardra-2neutral
MoonCancer8°04′11Pushya-2own sign
MarsTaurus29°19′9Mrigashira-2neutral, combust
MercuryGemini28°10′10Punarvasu-3own sign, vargottama
JupiterPisces3°28′7Uttara Bhadrapada-1own sign
VenusTaurus8°18′9Krittika-4own sign
SaturnAries7°41′8Ashwini-3debilitated (cancellation candidate)
RahuLeo10°33′12Magha-4—
KetuAquarius10°33′6Shatabhisha-2—

Four planets in their own signs (Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus) is a strong base. Saturn is debilitated, but it is a {{term:neechabhanga|cancellation candidate}}: the rule sets differ, and a later stage tests them.

Remember
  • 9 grahas; Rahu–Ketu are the lunar nodes, always 180° apart.
  • Natural nature ≠ functional nature (Stage 4).
  • Exaltation and debilitation are opposite signs.

Practice: for each of your planets, say its karaka meaning and its dignity in one line.
lessons.listen: There are nine grahas. The Sun is the soul, father and authority. The Moon is the mind and mother. Mars is courage, siblings, land and conflict. Mercury is intellect, speech and trade. Jupiter is wisdom, children, wealth and the teacher. Venus is love, the wife, luxury and art. Saturn is discipline, delay, labour and service. Rahu and Ketu are the lunar nodes: Rahu is hunger, obsession and the foreign; Ketu is detachment, the past life and moksha. Jupiter and Venus are natural benefics, Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Ketu natural malefics, the Sun a mild malefic, and the Moon and Mercury depend on condition. Each planet has an exaltation sign where it is strongest and a debilitation sign opposite it where it is weakest.

quiz.w: Saturn is exalted in Libra (peak 20°) and debilitated in Aries, where yours sits.

quiz.q: Which planet is the natural karaka of the wife in a man’s chart?
quiz.w: Venus signifies the wife; Jupiter signifies the husband in a woman’s chart.
They are the points where the Moon’s orbit crosses the ecliptic: the eclipse points.

quiz.q: How many of your planets are in their own sign?
quiz.w: Moon in Cancer, Mercury in Gemini, Jupiter in Pisces and Venus in Taurus.

lessons.title: The twelve rashis
lessons.body:
Each {{term:rashi|rashi}} is a 30° slice of the sidereal zodiac, starting from 0° Aries. A planet in a sign behaves in that sign’s manner and answers to the sign’s lord.

#SignSanskritLordElementModalityBody
1AriesMesha मेषMarsFireMovableHead
2TaurusVrishabha वृषभVenusEarthFixedFace, throat
3GeminiMithuna मिथुनMercuryAirDualArms, shoulders, lungs
4CancerKarka कर्कMoonWaterMovableChest, heart
5LeoSimha सिंहSunFireFixedUpper belly, spine
6VirgoKanya कन्याMercuryEarthDualIntestines, waist
7LibraTula तुलाVenusAirMovableLower belly, kidneys
8ScorpioVrishchika वृश्चिकMarsWaterFixedReproductive organs
9SagittariusDhanu धनुJupiterFireDualThighs, hips
10CapricornMakara मकरSaturnEarthMovableKnees
11AquariusKumbha कुम्भSaturnAirFixedCalves, ankles
12PiscesMeena मीनJupiterWaterDualFeet

Three ways to group the signs

GroupingTypesWhat it tells you
ElementFire (1, 5, 9) · Earth (2, 6, 10) · Air (3, 7, 11) · Water (4, 8, 12)Temperament: drive, practicality, ideas, feeling
ModalityMovable (1, 4, 7, 10) · Fixed (2, 5, 8, 11) · Dual (3, 6, 9, 12)Starting, holding or adapting. Also used in the navamsa formula and Jaimini.
GenderOdd = masculine, outgoing · Even = feminine, receptiveStyle of expression; used in divisional charts

Notice the pattern: the elements repeat every 4 signs, the modalities every 3. Fire–earth–air–water, movable–fixed–dual. Learn that and you never need to memorise the table.

Sign lords

The Sun owns Leo, the Moon owns Cancer, and each other planet owns two signs, mirrored around the Cancer–Leo line: Mercury (Gemini, Virgo), Venus (Taurus, Libra), Mars (Aries, Scorpio), Jupiter (Pisces, Sagittarius), Saturn (Aquarius, Capricorn).

In your chart

Lagna Virgo: earth, dual, even, ruled by Mercury. Analytical, detail-driven, service-minded, adaptable, self-critical. Your lagna lord Mercury sits in its own sign Gemini in the 10th, so your sense of self runs through your work.

Remember
  • Elements repeat every 4 signs; modalities every 3.
  • Lords mirror around Cancer–Leo.
  • Your lagna Virgo → Mercury is your chart’s ruler.

Practice: close the table and write the 12 signs with lord, element and modality from the patterns alone.
lessons.listen: The twelve rashis are equal thirty degree signs. Each has an element: fire, earth, air or water. Each has a modality: movable signs start things, fixed signs hold things, dual signs adapt. Odd signs are masculine and outgoing, even signs feminine and receptive. Each sign has a planetary lord, and each rules a part of the body from head to feet. Your lagna is Virgo: an earth, dual, feminine sign ruled by Mercury. That makes you analytical, detailed, service minded and adaptable, and it makes Mercury your most important planet.

quiz.w: Signs 3, 6, 9, 12 are dual; Virgo is sign 6.
Saturn rules Capricorn and Aquarius.
Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces.

lessons.title: The twelve bhavas
lessons.body:
A {{term:bhava|bhava}} is an area of life. Jyotish here uses whole-sign houses: the {{term:lagna|lagna}} sign is the 1st house, the next sign the 2nd, and so on round the zodiac.

HouseNameAreas of lifeGroupYours
1TanuSelf, body, personality, healthKendra + trikonaVirgo — Lagna
2DhanaWealth, family, speech, foodMarakaLibra
3SahajaCourage, siblings, effort, communicationUpachayaScorpio
4SukhaMother, home, vehicles, inner peace, propertyKendraSagittarius
5PutraChildren, intelligence, romance, past meritTrikonaCapricorn
6AriEnemies, debt, disease, service, competitionDusthana + upachayaAquarius — Ketu
7KalatraSpouse, partnership, business dealsKendra + marakaPisces — Jupiter
8AyuLongevity, sudden events, secrets, inheritance, occultDusthanaAries — Saturn
9BhagyaFortune, father, guru, dharma, long journeysTrikonaTaurus — Venus, Mars
10KarmaCareer, status, action, authorityKendra + upachayaGemini — Sun, Mercury
11LabhaGains, income, network, elder siblings, wishesUpachayaCancer — Moon
12VyayaLosses, expenses, foreign lands, sleep, mokshaDusthanaLeo — Rahu

The four house groups

GroupHousesMeaning
{{term:kendra|kendra}}1, 4, 7, 10Pillars: strength, visibility, action
{{term:trikona|trikona}}1, 5, 9Fortune and merit: lords counted auspicious (a second lordship can mix the result)
{{term:dusthana|dusthana}}6, 8, 12Difficulty: disease, upheaval, loss
{{term:upachaya|upachaya}}3, 6, 10, 11Grow with time and effort; malefics do well

A house is read from three things: the sign on it, any planets in it, and where its lord sits. Example: your 10th (career) holds Gemini, contains the Sun and Mercury, and its lord Mercury is in the 10th itself — a career house that is strongly self-owned.

The 2nd and 7th are also called maraka houses (they “spend” from the longevity houses 3 and 8). Maraka literally means "killer" and classically relates to longevity late in life. This course never predicts death. In everyday reading, treat these houses as expenses and strain.

In your chart

Kendras: Jupiter in the 7th (Hamsa yoga), Mercury in the 10th in its own sign (Bhadra yoga), with the Sun alongside (Budha-Aditya). Dusthanas: Ketu in the 6th, Saturn in the 8th (Harsha yoga, success through adversity), Rahu in the 12th. Trikona: Venus and Mars in the 9th, fortune via father and dharma.

Remember
  • House = sign + occupants + lord’s placement.
  • Kendra 1-4-7-10, trikona 1-5-9, dusthana 6-8-12, upachaya 3-6-10-11.

Practice: pick your 7th house and read it the three ways: sign (Pisces), occupant (Jupiter), lord (Jupiter, in the 7th).
lessons.listen: The twelve bhavas are the areas of life. In the whole sign system your lagna sign is the first house and the signs follow in order. House one is the self, two wealth and family, three courage and siblings, four mother and home, five children and intelligence, six enemies, debt and service, seven the spouse, eight longevity and sudden events, nine fortune and father, ten career, eleven gains, and twelve losses, foreign lands and moksha. Kendras one, four, seven and ten are the pillars. Trikonas one, five and nine bring fortune. Dusthanas six, eight and twelve bring difficulty. Upachayas three, six, ten and eleven grow with effort.

quiz.w: 6, 8 and 12 are the difficult houses.
Virgo is 1st, so Gemini is the 10th.

o: Its sign, its occupants and where its lord sits
quiz.w: All three together.

lessons.title: The twenty-seven nakshatras
lessons.body:
Thirteen-degree slices, one for each day of the Moon’s month: these are the {{term:nakshatra|nakshatras}}. Each is split into four {{term:pada|padas}}. Tradition holds that they are older than the 12 signs in Indian texts. They carry the finer story of a placement.

The lord sequence (learn this by heart)

Ketu → Venus → Sun → Moon → Mars → Rahu → Jupiter → Saturn → Mercury

It repeats three times (9 × 3 = 27). It is also the order of the Vimshottari {{term:dasha|dasha}}: your first dasha is the lord of your Moon’s nakshatra, and the dashas follow in this order.

#NakshatraSpan (sidereal)LordDeitySymbolGanaYours
1AshwiniAri 0°00′ – Ari 13°20′KetuAshwini KumarasHorse’s headDevaYour Saturn
2BharaniAri 13°20′ – Ari 26°40′VenusYamaYoniManushya
3KrittikaAri 26°40′ – Tau 10°00′SunAgniRazor, flameRakshasaYour Venus

6ArdraGem 6°40′ – Gem 20°00′RahuRudraTeardropManushyaYour Sun
7PunarvasuGem 20°00′ – Can 3°20′JupiterAditiQuiver of arrowsDevaYour Mercury
8PushyaCan 3°20′ – Can 16°40′SaturnBrihaspatiCow’s udder, flowerDevaYour Moon
9AshleshaCan 16°40′ – Can 30°00′MercuryNagasCoiled serpentRakshasa
10MaghaLeo 0°00′ – Leo 13°20′KetuPitris (ancestors)ThroneRakshasaYour Rahu
11Purva PhalguniLeo 13°20′ – Leo 26°40′VenusBhagaFront legs of a bedManushya
12Uttara PhalguniLeo 26°40′ – Vir 10°00′SunAryamanBack legs of a bedManushya
13HastaVir 10°00′ – Vir 23°20′MoonSavitarHandDeva
14ChitraVir 23°20′ – Lib 6°40′MarsTvashtarBright jewelRakshasa
15SwatiLib 6°40′ – Lib 20°00′RahuVayuYoung shoot in windDeva
16VishakhaLib 20°00′ – Sco 3°20′JupiterIndra-AgniTriumphal archRakshasa
17AnuradhaSco 3°20′ – Sco 16°40′SaturnMitraLotusDeva
18JyeshthaSco 16°40′ – Sco 30°00′MercuryIndraEarring, umbrellaRakshasa
19MulaSag 0°00′ – Sag 13°20′KetuNirritiBunch of rootsRakshasa
20Purva AshadhaSag 13°20′ – Sag 26°40′VenusApas (waters)Fan, tuskManushya
21Uttara AshadhaSag 26°40′ – Cap 10°00′SunVishvedevasElephant tuskManushya
22ShravanaCap 10°00′ – Cap 23°20′MoonVishnuEar, three footprintsDeva
23DhanishtaCap 23°20′ – Aqu 6°40′MarsEight VasusDrumRakshasa

25Purva BhadrapadaAqu 20°00′ – Pis 3°20′JupiterAja EkapadaFront of a funeral cotManushya
26Uttara BhadrapadaPis 3°20′ – Pis 16°40′SaturnAhirbudhnyaBack of a funeral cotManushyaYour Jupiter
27RevatiPis 16°40′ – Pis 30°00′MercuryPushanFishDeva

How a nakshatra changes a reading

The nakshatra lord is the channel a planet delivers through. Your Mercury in Punarvasu (Jupiter’s) carries Jupiter’s teaching quality into your 10th-house work. Your Ketu in Shatabhisha (“hundred physicians”, deity Varuna) gives a healer–researcher undertone to your 6th-house service.

In your chart

Moon in Pushya pada 2 (Cancer 8°04′). Pushya’s lord is Saturn, so you were born in Saturn’s dasha. Its deity Brihaspati, the guru of the gods, colours your mind with duty and a pull toward teaching and right conduct. Pushya is Deva gana.

Remember
  • 27 × 13°20′; each has 4 padas of 3°20′.
  • Lord order Ketu–Venus–Sun–Moon–Mars–Rahu–Jupiter–Saturn–Mercury = dasha order.
  • Moon’s nakshatra lord = your first dasha.

Practice: recite the 9-lord sequence ten times; then name the nakshatra of each of your planets from memory.
lessons.listen: The zodiac is also divided into twenty seven nakshatras of thirteen degrees twenty minutes each, the lunar mansions. Each has four padas of three degrees twenty minutes. Their lords repeat in a fixed order: Ketu, Venus, Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, three times round. This same order and these lords run the Vimshottari dasha. Each nakshatra also has a deity, a symbol and a gana. Your Moon is in Pushya, ruled by Saturn with Brihaspati as deity: a nakshatra traditionally regarded as highly auspicious, tied to nourishment and steady growth. That is why your life began in a Saturn dasha.

quiz.q: Which lord comes after Rahu in the sequence?
quiz.w: …Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury.

quiz.q: Your birth dasha lord is Saturn because…
o: Your Moon is in Pushya, ruled by Saturn
You were born on a Saturday
quiz.w: The Moon’s nakshatra lord starts the Vimshottari clock.

lessons.title: Reading one placement in four steps
lessons.body:
The four steps

  1. Planet: what it signifies (karaka).
  2. Sign: dignity and style. Strong or weak? Fiery or earthy?
  3. House: where in life — plus the houses it rules for your lagna.
  4. Nakshatra lord: the channel it delivers through.

Then add aspects (drishti)

Every graha aspects the 7th house from itself. Three have extra aspects: Mars the 4th and 8th, Jupiter the 5th and 9th, Saturn the 3rd and 10th. Many teachers give Rahu and Ketu the 5th and 9th too; others give them only the 7th, and Jaimini uses sign-based aspects instead. Texts differ.

Worked example 1 — your Mercury

StepFindingMeaning
PlanetMercuryIntellect, speech, trade
SignGemini, own sign, {{term:vargottama|vargottama}}Strong, reliable, quick and verbal
House10th; rules the 1st and 10thIdentity and career fused: Bhadra yoga
NakshatraPunarvasu (Jupiter)Delivers through teaching, advising, renewal

Read together: a sharp business and communication mind whose work is his identity, with an advisory, teaching tone.

Worked example 2 — your Saturn

StepFindingMeaning
PlanetSaturnDiscipline, delay, labour, longevity
SignAries, debilitated — {{term:neechabhanga|cancellation candidate}}Weak start, strength gained later
House8th; rules the 5th and 6thUpheaval and hidden matters; 6th lord in 8th = Harsha (Viparita Raja) yoga
NakshatraAshwini (Ketu)Sudden, detached, healing quality
Aspects3rd → Gemini (10th), 7th → Libra (2nd), 10th → Capricorn (5th)Career, family wealth and children feel Saturn’s slow discipline

Read together: tradition reads success that comes through crises, debts and delays, not around them. That is Harsha yoga: the adversity is the ladder.

Remember
  • Planet → sign → house (+ rulership) → nakshatra lord → aspects.
  • Special aspects: Mars 4/8, Jupiter 5/9, Saturn 3/10.

Practice: do the four steps for your Venus (Taurus, 9th, Krittika). Check your answer in Lesson 1-7.
lessons.listen: To read any placement, follow four steps. First, what the planet signifies. Second, its sign and dignity: how strong and in what style. Third, its house and the houses it rules: where in life. Fourth, its nakshatra lord: the channel it delivers through. Then add aspects. Every planet aspects the seventh house from itself; Mars also the fourth and eighth, Jupiter the fifth and ninth, Saturn the third and tenth. For example, your Saturn: discipline and delay, debilitated in Aries with a cancellation candidate, in the eighth house of upheaval while ruling the fifth and sixth, in Ashwini ruled by Ketu. Tradition reads this as hard-won success through crises, a Viparita Raja Yoga (Harsha).

quiz.q: Which houses does Jupiter aspect from itself?
quiz.w: Jupiter: 5th, 7th, 9th.

quiz.q: Your Saturn aspects your 10th house via its…
quiz.w: From Aries, the 3rd sign is Gemini, your 10th.
A Viparita Raja yoga: your 6th lord Saturn in the 8th.

lessons.title: Your chart, start to finish + stage test
lessons.body:

lessons.listen: Put everything together. Your lagna is Virgo, ruled by Mercury in its own sign in the tenth: a builder whose identity is his work. Your Moon in Cancer in the eleventh, in Pushya: a protective, dutiful mind that gains through people. Venus in its own sign in the ninth with Mars: fortune through father and values, with a love of beauty. Jupiter in its own sign in the seventh: tradition reads a wise, ethical spouse, a statement to log and test, not a fact. Saturn debilitated in the eighth, a cancellation candidate: tradition reads success through adversity. Rahu in the twelfth: hunger for recognition and the spiritual. Ketu in the sixth: past life mastery in service and healing. Stages 4 and 8 teach how strong each of these really is.

quiz.w: Mars is about 11° from the Sun, inside the 17° orb (a Surya Siddhanta/BPHS value; some teachers use smaller orbs).
